newsitem.title: USA: Alliance gets court nod for DIP financing.
newsitem.headline: Alliance gets court nod for DIP financing.

text.p: Alliance Entertainment Corp said Thursday it had received court approval of interim debtor-in-possession financing provided under a loan agreement with a syndicate of banks led by Chase Manhattan.
The company said the court approved $20 million of the $50 million DIP financing intended to support operations.
It said the court approved its requests for payment of certain pre-petition wages and benefits, retention of its cash management systems and retention of legal and financial professionals.
It said a final hearing for the remaining $30 million of the DIP financing has been scheduled July 30.

Separately, the company also confirmed that the New York Stock Exchange had permanently halted trading of Alliance stock because of its Chapter 11 filing and said that the company no longer met the criteria for continued listing.
Alliance is a fully integrated, independent music company with more than 1,300 employees in the United States, Canada and Britain.
